test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The documents are signed by the director before submission.

options.text: The documents are being signed by the director before submission.
The director signs the documents before submission.
The director has signed the documents before submission.
The director signed the documents before submission.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The documents are signed by the director before submission."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the director" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "are signed" to the active verb form "signs."
 
• Ensure the rest of the sentence structure remains intact for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The director signs the documents before submission."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The documents are being signed by the director before submission." – This is still in passive voice.
 
• **Option 3: **"The director has signed the documents before submission." – Incorrect tense (present perfect).
 
• **Option 4: **"The director signed the documents before submission." – Incorrect tense (past simple).
